title: Huacachina Oasis and Dune Buggies
description: Enjoy an exciting adventure in the Ica desert. Ride dune buggies over the dunes, try sandboarding and relax at the Huacachina oasis, a green emerald in the middle of the desert.

itinerary.title: Ica → Huacachina → Ica
itinerary.description: Hotel pickup at 9:00 am. Transfer to the desert for a 1-hour dune buggy ride over the dunes. Then 45 minutes of sandboarding on the highest dunes. Arrival at the Huacachina oasis for free time and photos. Return at 4:00 pm.
